# DoNotKYC

> Independent directory of 44 crypto exchanges, instant swaps, P2P markets, Bitcoin ATMs and bridges that let people trade without sending an ID document. Each platform is sorted by how much identity it asks for. Rankings are not for sale; affiliate links are disclosed.

Identity levels: None = no ID and no account details; Light = no ID under a stated limit, or only an email or phone number; Tiered = ID required above a threshold.

## Key pages
- [Directory](https://www.donotkyc.com/): every platform, filterable by type, identity level, card or bank deposit and US availability
- [How we check platforms](https://www.donotkyc.com/methodology): identity levels, sources and the real-money test protocol
- [Compare platforms](https://www.donotkyc.com/compare): 17 side-by-side comparisons
- [Changelog](https://www.donotkyc.com/changelog): dated changes to listings
- [Open data](https://www.donotkyc.com/nokyc_directory.json): the full directory as JSON

## Platforms
- [1inch](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/1inch): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: Variable (aggregator).
- [AceChange](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/acechange): Instant swap. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No ID for crypto swaps. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.5%+ for swaps. Not available in: US, for some swaps.
- [Best Wallet](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/best-wallet): Instant swap. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account. Crypto only. Fees: Low (competitive).
- [BIM Exchange](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bim-exchange): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.1% - 0.5% (via Kyber/Bungee).
- [Bisq](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bisq): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account at all. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Variable.
- [Boltz](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/boltz): Instant swap. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account. Crypto only. Fees: 0.25%. UNDER REVIEW: Boltz suspended its swaps on 3 August 2026 and its website no longer resolves. Do not send funds until the service is back.
- [DeGate](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/degate): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.01% stable coins; 0.1% for gas tokens; 0.25% Most CEX-listed tokens; 0.99% all others.
- [dYdX](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/dydx): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: 0.02% - 0.05%. Not available in: US, Canada.
- [edgeX](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/edgex): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker.
- [GhostSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/ghostswap): Bridge. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account. Crypto only. Fees: <0.5%.
- [Hodl Hodl](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/hodl-hodl): P2P market. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No ID, on-chain escrow. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Variable.
- [Hyperliquid](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/hyperliquid): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: Low.
- [LocalCoinSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/localcoinswap): P2P market. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No ID unless there is a dispute or an alert. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Low.
- [Nonkyc.io](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/nonkyc-io): Exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No ID at any amount. Crypto only. Fees: 0.2%.
- [PancakeSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/pancakeswap): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: 0.25%.
- [Peach Bitcoin](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/peach-bitcoin): P2P market. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No ID. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Free to sell.
- [Portal Bridge](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/portal-bridge): Bridge. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: Variable (gas dependent).
- [Quickex.io](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/quickex-io): Instant swap. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account. Crypto only. Fees: 0.5% fixed fee + network fees.
- [SilentSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/silentswap): Instant swap. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). No account. Crypto only. Fees: 1% flat fee per swap. Not available in: US.
- [Symbiosis Finance](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/symbiosis-finance): Bridge. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: Low.
- [Synapse Protocol](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/synapse-protocol): Bridge. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: Near-zero with reimbursement.
- [Uniswap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/uniswap): Decentralised exchange. Identity: None (no ID, no account details). Wallet only. Crypto only. Fees: 0.05% - 1%.
- [BloFin](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/blofin): Exchange. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID can be required at any time. Crypto only. Fees: 0.02% maker / 0.06% taker.
- [Changelly](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/changelly): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID can be required at any time. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.25%. Not available in: US.
- [ChangeNOW](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/changenow): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID only if a swap is flagged. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Included in the rate. Not available in: Not stated.
- [CoinEx](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/coinex): Exchange. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). No ID up to $10,000 a day. Crypto only. Fees: 0.2%. Not available in: New York.
- [FixedFloat](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/fixedfloat): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID only if a swap is flagged. Crypto only. Fees: 1% fixed rate, 0.5% floating rate. Not available in: US, Georgia, India.
- [KCEX](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/kcex): Exchange. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). No ID at low limits. Crypto only. Fees: 0% spot, 0.02% taker futures, 0% maker futures. Not available in: Some regions.
- [OpenPeer](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/openpeer): P2P market. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). The seller decides. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Low. Not available in: US.
- [PrimeXBT](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/primexbt): Exchange. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). No ID up to about $20,000 a day. Crypto only. Fees: 0.01% - 0.05%. Not available in: US.
- [RockitCoin](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/rockitcoin): Bitcoin ATM. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). Phone number only. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Spread + $1-2. Not available in: Outside US, Puerto Rico.
- [SimpleSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/simpleswap): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID only if a swap is flagged. Crypto only. Fees: Variable. Not available in: US.
- [StealthEX](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/stealthex): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). ID can be required, no limit published. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.25% - 0.5% (varies by pair & network).
- [Tapbit](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/tapbit): Exchange. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). No ID up to 2 BTC. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 0.1% spot, 0.02% maker | 0.06% taker futures. Not available in: Some regions.
- [Trocador](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/trocador): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). Depends on the partner. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Included in partner rate; network + partner fees in quote.
- [WizardSwap](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/wizardswap): Instant swap. Identity: Light (no ID under a limit, or only email/phone). May freeze a flagged swap. Crypto only. Fees: Approx. 2.2% flat fee, with possibility to earn fee rebate by providing liquidity.
- [BingX](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bingx): Exchange. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). ID above the first tier. Crypto only. Fees: 0.075% - 0.2%. Not available in: US.
- [Bitcoin Depot](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bitcoin-depot): Bitcoin ATM. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). ID above small cash amounts. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Variable. Not available in: Outside the southern US.
- [Bitcoin Well](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bitcoin-well): Bitcoin ATM. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). ID above the first tier. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Variable. Not available in: Outside Canada, US.
- [Bybit](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/bybit): Exchange. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). No ID to withdraw up to 20,000 USDT a day, ID to trade. Crypto only. Fees: 0.01% - 0.1%. Not available in: US, UK, Singapore.
- [Coinstar Bitcoin Machines](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/coinstar-bitcoin-machines): Bitcoin ATM. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). ID above small cash amounts. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 4-11%. Not available in: Outside the US.
- [LibertyX ATM](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/libertyx-atm): Bitcoin ATM. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). ID above the first tier. Card or bank accepted. Fees: 8%. Not available in: Outside the US.
- [MEXC](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/mexc): Exchange. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). No ID up to 10 BTC a day. Crypto only. Fees: 0.025% - 0.2%. Not available in: US.
- [Mt Pelerin](https://www.donotkyc.com/p/mt-pelerin): Exchange. Identity: Tiered (ID above a threshold). No ID up to set limits. Card or bank accepted. Fees: Low fees. Not available in: Outside Europe.
